note: From the 2026-08-05 register pass. Munich was already published (10 trees, 2026-07-25); this pass mined the full Naturdenkmal ordinance rather than opening the city. 116 of the 117 monuments parsed with coordinates, covering 196 individual trees. Leads failed only on age, which is the expensive field in Germany. Blocked can never ship as they stand: private ownership, group monuments that are not a collectible point, or public ownership without public access.
